title: Which metric got left behind?
hook: A click increase shares the screen with a revenue result.

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: clicks go up while revenue or retention quietly drops.

misconception: Treating guardrail metrics as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: clicks go up while revenue or retention quietly drops.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: Per 1,000 visits a baseline has 100 clicks and revenue 2,000; a variant has 150 clicks and revenue 1,750. What revenue change accompanies the click increase?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-guardrail-metrics/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Per1000 visits baseline clicks100,purchases40,revenue2000; variant clicks150,purchases35,revenue1750. CTR+50%, revenue-12.5%; move attention from clicks to guardrail outcomes.

src/demos/probability/p100-guardrail-metrics/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Per1000 visits baseline clicks100,purchases40,revenue2000; variant clicks150,purchases35,revenue1750. CTR+50%, revenue-12.5%; move attention from clicks to guardrail outcomes.

claims.text: The revenue guardrail retains −12.5%, while the click target retains +50%. The variant’s extra clicks do not translate into more purchases in these stipulated counts.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-guardrail-metrics/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Per1000 visits baseline clicks100,purchases40,revenue2000; variant clicks150,purchases35,revenue1750. CTR+50%, revenue-12.5%; move attention from clicks to guardrail outcomes.

claims.text: A target metric can improve while another important outcome worsens. Predeclared guardrails make that tradeoff visible; these aggregate arithmetic differences alone do not establish statistical certainty or a launch decision.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-guardrail-metrics/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Per1000 visits baseline clicks100,purchases40,revenue2000; variant clicks150,purchases35,revenue1750. CTR+50%, revenue-12.5%; move attention from clicks to guardrail outcomes.

claims.text: Clicks rise 20% while revenue falls 5%. Does the click win establish a business win? The decision needs the predeclared goals, guardrails and uncertainty, rather than a selected winning metric.
